name: Jeera water
description: Cumin seed boiled in water and cooled — the everyday digestive glass.

tcm.note: Cumin is warm and moves the middle burner.

ayurveda.note: Jiraka is ushna and deepana-pachana — kindling for a dull digestion.

effects.note: Ayurveda's deepana-pachana reputation for cumin — kindling a sluggish digestion — is echoed in everyday South Asian home use well beyond the classical texts. A possible effect, not a promise — response to it varies from person to person.
